ARES Navigator · Research and education prototypeGrid-scale slope and hypothetical travel estimates · No operational EVA use

Data sources and methods

Coordinates are planetocentric and east-positive. Distances use a 3,389.5 km spherical Mars. Elevation is sampled from numerical rasters. Slope and route statistics are derived. Walk speed, slope penalties, and science activities are mission assumptions.

Terrain resolution limits what can be inferred about rocks, sand, and small obstacles. Inspect each product's datum before comparing elevation values across products.
